info.name: TERN API — Complete
info.description: Full TERN API test suite — 81 requests across 10 folders. Run folders top-to-bottom in collection runner order: Auth → Models → Permissions → Collab → Locks → Drivers → Notifications → Admin → STM Templates → RBAC Matrix. Requests that depend on earlier steps are automatically skipped when the prerequisite environment variable is not set.

variable.description: Set in the active environment file (e.g. http://localhost:3000)
MANUAL: copy the token query param from the verification email link before running Verify Email
Existing seed model used for read operations
Name of the model created by Save Model and deleted by Delete Model
MANUAL: a state_id from GET /models/:name response (states[n].state_id)
MANUAL: a transition id from GET /models/:name response (transitions[n].id)
MANUAL: a non-admin user ID for Delete User / Revoke Sessions tests
Auto-set by [Reviewer] Can post comment in RBAC Matrix; auto-deleted in [Cleanup]
Auto-set by [Admin] Can post comment in RBAC Matrix; auto-deleted in [Cleanup]
Auto-set by [Admin] Can create milestone in RBAC Matrix; auto-deleted in [Cleanup]

item.name: Register
item.description: Returns 201 on first run, 409 on repeat runs (email already registered). Both are accepted.

item.name: Verify Email
item.description: MANUAL STEP: set verificationToken collection variable to the token from the verification email link before running. Skipped automatically when verificationToken is not set.

item.name: List Assigned
item.description: Returns all models the requesting user has a model-level role on, along with their role. Response: { models: [...] }.

item.name: Save Model
item.description: Creates or updates a model. Response: { success: true, modelId: N }. Requires global Editor or Admin AND model-level editor role (Admin bypasses model role check).

item.name: Clone From Template
item.description: Response: { success: true, modelId: N, stm_name: '...' }. Requires global Admin or Editor role.

item.name: Delete State
item.description: Deletes a single state (node). Requires global Editor role AND model-level editor role. SKIPPED when testStateId is not set — obtain from GET /models/:name response (states[n].state_id).

item.name: Delete Transition
item.description: Deletes a single transition (edge). Requires global Editor role AND model-level editor role. SKIPPED when testTransitionId is not set — obtain from GET /models/:name response (transitions[n].id).

item.name: Get Review Lock
item.description: Returns the permanent review lock status. Available to any model role. Response: { is_locked: boolean, locked_by?, locked_at?, lock_reason? }.

item.name: Lock for Review
item.description: Permanently locks a model for review. Admin only. The next request (Unlock from Review) immediately reverses it to keep the suite clean.

exec: pm.test('Model is now locked', function() { pm.expect(json.is_locked).to.be.true; });

item.name: Unlock from Review
item.description: Removes the permanent review lock. Admin only. Restores model to editable state.

item.name: Delete Model
item.description: Deletes the model created by Save Model. Admin only. Will fail if model is review-locked.

item.name: List Permissions
item.description: Returns all model_permissions rows for a model. Model owner or Admin only.

item.name: Grant Role
item.description: Upserts a per-model role. Role must be one of: owner, editor, reviewer, viewer (lowercase). Model owner or Admin only. Response: { success, stm_name, user_email, role }.

item.name: Revoke Role
item.description: Removes a per-model role assignment. Model owner or Admin only. Response: { success, stm_name, user_email }.

item.name: Get Comments
item.description: Response: { comments: [...], total: N, limit: N, offset: N }.

item.name: Post Comment
item.description: Response: { comment: { id, body, entityType, entityId, parentId, createdAt, ... } }. Requires model owner, editor, or reviewer role.

item.description: Marks a comment as resolved. SKIPPED when testCommentId is not set.

item.name: Delete Comment
item.description: Deletes a comment. SKIPPED when testCommentId is not set.

item.name: List Milestones
item.description: Response: { milestones: [...] }. Available to all model roles.

item.name: Create Milestone
item.description: Snapshots the current model. Response: { milestone: { id, label, createdAt, snapshot } }. Requires model owner or editor role.

exec: pm.test('Has milestone object with id', function() {

item.name: Get Milestone
item.description: Returns a single milestone by ID. Response: { milestone: { id, label, createdAt, snapshot } }. SKIPPED when testMilestoneId is not set.

item.name: Restore from Milestone
item.description: Overwrites the current model with the milestone snapshot. WARNING: destructive. Requires model owner or editor role. SKIPPED when testMilestoneId is not set.

item.name: Delete Milestone
item.description: Permanently deletes a milestone snapshot. Admin only. SKIPPED when testMilestoneId is not set.

item.name: Acquire Lock
item.description: Acquires or refreshes an exclusive editing lock. Response: { success, locked, lockId, lockedBy, owner, lock_type, expiresAt }. lock_type is 'review' for reviewer model role, 'edit' otherwise.

item.name: Get Lock Status
item.description: Response when locked: { locked: true, lockId, lockedBy, expiresAt, owner, lock_type }. Response when unlocked: { locked: false }.

item.name: Renew Lock
item.description: Extends lock TTL by 120 seconds. SKIPPED when testLockId is not set.

item.name: Release Lock
item.description: Releases an editing lock. Only the lock owner can release. SKIPPED when testLockId is not set.

item.name: Get Mentions
item.description: Response: { mentions: [...] }.

item.name: Mark Read
item.description: Sets notified_at = NOW() for the provided mention IDs. Returns 204 No Content on success.

item.name: Stats
item.description: Response: { totalUsers, verifiedUsers, unverifiedUsers, activeSessions }.

item.name: List Users
item.description: Response: { users: [...], total, page, totalPages }.

item.description: Filter by role. Valid values: Viewer, Editor, Admin (capitalized).

item.description: Case-insensitive substring match on email or contributor name using ?search param.

item.name: Update User Role
item.description: Role must be one of: Viewer, Editor, Admin (capitalized). Cannot change your own role. SKIPPED when testUserId is not set.

item.name: Audit Log
item.description: Returns the most recent 20 audit log entries with actor email.

item.name: Revoke User Sessions
item.description: Deletes all session rows for a user. Response: { message, count }. SKIPPED when testDeleteUserId is not set.

item.name: Delete User
item.description: Permanently deletes a user account. Cannot delete yourself or the last Admin. SKIPPED when testDeleteUserId is not set.

item.name: RBAC Matrix
item.description: Comprehensive RBAC tests. Setup grants model roles (editor user → reviewer, viewer user → viewer on Woodlands); teardown revokes them and deletes test data. Run Auth folder first to populate all three tokens.

item.name: [Setup] Grant Editor user → reviewer model role on Woodlands
item.description: Uses admin token to grant the editor account the 'reviewer' model role. All [Reviewer] tests depend on this. Skipped when editorAccessToken is not set.

exec: pm.test('Status 200 — reviewer role granted to editor user', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: [Setup] Grant Viewer user → viewer model role on Woodlands
item.description: Uses admin token to grant the viewer account the 'viewer' model role. All [Viewer] read tests depend on this. Skipped when viewerAccessToken is not set.

exec: pm.test('Status 200 — viewer role granted to viewer user', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
